advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Strengthen the actionlint scope guard to assert the invocation takes no path argument (positive invariant) rather than only rejecting a release.yml-scoped arg.
evidence: The docstring frames the invariant as 'actionlint must lint ALL workflows' but the regex only flags a release.yml-scoped arg — any non-empty path arg other than release.yml (e.g. a glob or another single workflow) narrows scope yet is not matched.
ABSENCE: no assertion that the actionlint invocation carries NO path argument at all (the positive invariant), only a negative check against one specific path.
The regex hard-codes both these tokens; a rename of `al` or the bin var silently voids the match and the assertion `scoped is None` trivially holds.
advisory.finding: The guard test `test_actionlint_not_scoped_to_release_yml` only detects re-narrowing to `release.yml` specifically (via `$(RELEASE_WORKFLOW)` or a `*release.yml` path). A future re-narrowing to any OTHER subset (e.g. an explicit glob, a directory arg, or a single non-release workflow path) would leave the bug-8002 class open but pass this guard silently.
merged_from: The guard test is coupled to the exact literal invocation tokens `"$$al"` and `$(LOCAL_BIN)/actionlint` in the recipe. A benign refactor of the recipe (e.g. renaming the shell var `$al`, or invoking via a different indirection) would make the regex match nothing, causing the guard to pass vacuously even if scope were later re-narrowed.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Make test_lint_still_invokes_actionlint assert on the actionlint EXECUTION (e.g. strip `@#` comment lines from _lint_recipe() before checking, or match the `"$$al"`/`$(LOCAL_BIN)/actionlint` invocation) so removing the invocation while leaving a comment fails the test.
evidence: tests/unit/test_ci_actionlint_scope.py:37: assert "actionlint" in _lint_recipe(), "make lint no longer invokes actionlint"
_lint_recipe() collects every tab-indented line after `lint:` including `@#` comments (tests/unit/test_ci_actionlint_scope.py:28-31)

Makefile:103 `@# actionlint below validates ALL workflows...` and Makefile:105/107/111 comments contain the word 'actionlint' — so the substring is present independent of the invocation lines Makefile:112-119
advisory.finding: test_lint_still_invokes_actionlint asserts only that the substring "actionlint" appears anywhere in the lint recipe, but _lint_recipe() includes the tab-indented `@#` comment lines (Makefile:101-111) which mention "actionlint" repeatedly. The actual actionlint invocation lines (Makefile:112-119, `"$$al"` / `"$(LOCAL_BIN)/actionlint"`) could be silently deleted while an explanatory comment survives, and this test would still pass — defeating its stated purpose of guarding against silent removal.
advisory.suggested_fix: Filter comment lines in _lint_recipe() (drop lines whose stripped form starts with `@#` or `#`) before the substring check, or assert the actionlint invocation pattern (e.g. re.search(r'"\$\$al"$|\$\(LOCAL_BIN\)/actionlint"', recipe)) rather than the bare word.
